committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 24 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Weekly ad spend eased to A$129.20 from A$140.62, with clicks down to 19 from 24, holding at A$6.80 per click, in line with the A$7 cap.

No external account changes were logged in the last 24 hours or 7 days (adsChanges status: ok), so none of the landing page test's 57 raw clicks or 10 ask_cta_click events need discounting for outside interference.

The dedicated landing page has logged 10 ask_cta_click events against 57 raw paid clicks since 6 October, with zero review_cta_click or calculator_used recorded; the click count is well past the 25-click mark, so the headline, offer and CTAs stay frozen unless something breaks.

Organic Search sessions fell to 7 from 17 while Direct jumped to 28 from 15, which is not evidence of unpaid demand; AI Assistant sessions ticked up to 2 from 1, all via chatgpt.com, though this likely undercounts true AI referral traffic.

actions.text: The test has passed 25 raw clicks (57 so far), so the page headline, offer and CTAs remain frozen unless something is broken.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding and need to be supplied.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update them to match current site stats.
